review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend support for opportunity selection and status filtering, dependent on backend API implementation.
review.reason: Adds TypeScript types and Zod schemas for opportunity records, including draft constraints and status filtering, alongside frontend action and selector definitions. This establishes the frontend contract for opportunity selection and metadata retrieval. However, the backend API implementation and complete frontend implementation are not present, preventing a definitive assessment.
